title: Developer samples experiment dump - May 20 2026
content:
Meeting: Samples / SDK experiment sync (informal)
Date: 2026-05-20
Owner: Aisha Kumar (notes)
Attendees: Aisha, Marco, Priya, Ben, Sofia (joined for last 20m)

Purpose:
- Quick capture of small experiments we spun up this sprint for improving first-run experience in the Samples Playground and SDK quickstarts. This is a working dump — contains partial results, TODOs, and rough ideas to decide what to keep for next sprint.

1) Playground CLI v0.3 smoke runs
- Ran v0.3 on macOS and Linux containers. Improvements: progress bar, default sample selection heuristics are better. Repro: CLI hangs on step "download-model" for ~30s in one Docker env (ubuntu:22.04) — likely network timeout fallback not aggressive enough.
- Action: Marco to add a 10s connect timeout + log that prints retry attempts (JIRA-ENG-4521). Deadline: 2026-05-25.
- Note: For users on low bandwidth, fallback to a small quantized variant works well. Need to make that automatic rather than opt-in.

2) New onboarding playlist (experiment): "Guided demo for chat + embeddings"
- Structure: 3 short samples (hello-chat, search-over-docs, summarize-archive). Each sample is runnable in <90s with a free tier model or small local quantized model.
- Observations from field play tests (3 participants): the search sample confused users who expected "search across files" instead of "search across single uploaded doc".
- Decision: Rename sample to "Search in a doc" and add a short note about multi-doc use cases (deferred).
- Action: Priya to update sample names + short microcopy. Deadline: 2026-05-23.

3) SDK snippet telemetry noise
- Issue: sample SDK usage sends very high-frequency heartbeat events (every 2s) which overloads local dev telemetry and inflates analytics. Root cause: telemetry timer still at debug default.
- Temporary fix: reduce heartbeat frequency to 30s and batch events in local dev mode.
- Action: Ben to prepare PR to change default in both python/js SDK templates. Include flag to opt back into debug-rate. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/78
- QA note: confirm this doesn’t affect hosted API billing signals.

4) Quickstart for Next.js (canary)
- Canary run on two sample apps. Works end-to-end, but NPM install step breaks if user has older node-gyp globally installed.
- Workaround in docs: add node version pin + npm rebuild step. Ideally ship a dockerized reproducible dev container for the quickstart to avoid local envs.
- Action: Aisha to draft a minimal devcontainer definition and add to repo. Deadline: 2026-05-27.

5) Samples template catalogue clean-up
- We have drift: some templates reference old SDK helper APIs (deprecated). Suggested pass: automated lint job that flags templates using deprecated helpers.
- Quick plan: lint rule + CI job that comments on PRs touching /templates. Marco to prototype rule using AST check for helpers.
- Action: Marco to prototype by EOD 2026-05-24.

6) Metrics we want from field play (short list for next round)
- Time-to-first-successful-call (TTFSC)
- % of users who run the full playlist without errors
- Most common first error (install, auth, model download)
- Median wall-clock time for "download-model" step on Linux containers
- Action: Priya to assemble quick sheet with these metrics and capture from 10 new participants. Due: 2026-05-30.

7) UX and copy quick wins
- Add a tiny "why this sample" blurb at top of each sample (14–20 words).
- Replace phrase "model weights" with "model files" in beginner docs — less scary.
- Action: Sofia to run a copy pass on top 8 beginner samples. Due: 2026-05-26.

8) Open questions / brainstorms
- Should we provide an always-available "small-mode" (quantized default) in the Samples Playground to guarantee sub-2s cold-starts for demo rooms? Cost vs comprehension tradeoff.
- How opinionated should the quickstarts be about auth? (prefilled token vs guided flow)
- Idea: include a low-friction "guest sandbox" option for corporate demos that auto-cleans after 24h. Legal/security check needed.

9) Notes-to-self / rough TODOs
- Capture the field play videos and timestamp common failure modes (install, env, model download).
- Build a small harness to simulate low-bandwidth model downloads (to reproduce the 30s hang).
- Draft a one-pager for product about offering a "playground small-mode" as a paid addon for demo accounts.

10) Action items (compact)
- Marco: connect timeout + retry logging for CLI; prototype template linter (due 2026-05-24 / 2026-05-25).
- Priya: microcopy rename + metrics capture sheet (due 2026-05-23 / 2026-05-30).
- Ben: telemetry PR for SDK snippets (link above) (due 2026-05-22).
- Aisha: devcontainer for quickstart + draft product one-pager (due 2026-05-27).
- Sofia: copy pass top 8 samples (due 2026-05-26).

Quick log (timestamps during meeting):
- 10:02 - quick status + agenda check
- 10:08 - CLI hangs and model fallback discussion (Marco)
- 10:24 - field play feedback, rename decision (Priya)
- 10:33 - telemetry problem triage (Ben)
- 10:45 - quickstart reproducibility notes (Aisha)
- 10:52 - UX copy pass and next steps (Sofia)

End notes: save this as a working doc in Drive, we'll pull items into the sprint board later. If you add anything to the doc, put your initials and date after the line so we can track changes in the quick dump.

---

Initials log: Aisha K. (2026-05-20) — created; Marco L. (2026-05-20) — added CLI timeout note; Priya P. (2026-05-21) — field play metrics outline added.
